Frontend flows verified: landing, register, login, dashboard, programs list/detail, jobs, events + RSVP, resume builder save, admin login + admin page render. AI resume-assist works at API level but the UI did not visibly render returned bullets for the user during testing.

FRONTEND_URL points to old preview host '47abc6db-...preview.emergentagent.com' but the actual public URL is 'youth-worx-connect.preview.emergentagent.com'. rca of the issue: TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout failed with 500 instead of 429. Root cause: pymongo deserializes BSON dates without tzinfo; comparing rec['locked_until'] (naive) > datetime.now(timezone.utc) (aware) raises TypeError, caught by FastAPI as 500. Fix: replace tzinfo=timezone.utc on the naive value before comparison. After fix, lockout returns 429 after the 5th invalid login attempt as designed.
